maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from credit data, analytics, verification and monitoring subscriptions, not repairing or servicing installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly lenders, businesses, employers and consumers; government agencies are only a minor customer group.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through data, analytics and new products on the Equifax Cloud, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Lenders embed Equifax credit data, fraud and employment verification in underwriting workflows; switching requires integration, model recalibration and compliance work.
